comments.body: Former user would you mind checking out the proposed mappings one last time?
Nick Ruest, these look good except the audit module is using premis:ing (ingest) for addDatastream (and using premis:cre for creating an object).

Former user perfect!

Also, do you have an example crytographicHashFunction? I figure I should switch that over in our table of mappings as well.
That makes sense. The URI for MD5 is: http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/preservation/cryptographicHashFunctions/md5

If I'm understanding this right then, premis:hasMessageDigestAlgorithm would just have the associated URI for cryptographicHashFunctions? So, in the example it would be

premis:hasMessageDigestAlgorithm http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/preservation/cryptographicHashFunctions/sha1
premis:hasMessageDigest c91342b705b15cb4f6ac5362cc6a47d9425aec86

Do I need a predicated to relate those two values together? Or a blank node? Just thinking back to our technical metadata subgroup call, and I thought we had done it without the need for blank nodes.

The cryptographicHash terms are defined as both skos:Concept and owl:AnnotationProperty.

So I think it's fine to use them with the PREMIS predicates, and you'd need to have some kind of container if you had more than one of them. But you could also just use the cryptographicHash terms as predicates:

<object1> cryptofunc:sha1 "c91342b705b15cb4f6ac5362cc6a47d9425aec86"

IMHO, that's a lot simpler and allows you to have as many different checksums as you want without having to have a blanknode or other container to keep the algorithms and checksums matched up.

OH! I see now. Just needed that example

Thank you very much Former user!!!

Add the following auditTrail mappings to migration-utils:

addDatastream -> premis:ing

modifyDatastreamByReference -> audit:contentModification/metadataModification

modifyObject -> audit:resourceModification

modifyObject (checksum validation) -> premis:validation

modifyDatastreamByValue -> audit:contentModification/metadataModification

purgeDatastream -> audit:contentRemoval
